integrity: Proof and reproducible exhaustive small-case verifier supplied. Mathematical claims are restricted to the stated group presentation and assumptions. No independent mathematical validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs and graphical groups over fields of characteristic two only. The detailed rank census counts elementary abelian subgroups containing the canonical edge center, not all smaller elementary abelian subgroups. Maximal-by-inclusion classification does cover all elementary abelian subgroups of maximal inclusion. The rank and class formulas are self-contained proofs; general publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Characteristic-two graphical groups: involution classes and maximal elementary abelian subgroups
